downloads.bundleContents: Includes weights, tokenizer and the extra files required by this Strata model. Memory use also depends on context and launch settings.
downloads.purposeVision: Text and image understanding. Select a compatible image projector with the GGUF variant.
downloads.purposeEmbedding: Text embeddings for search and retrieval.
downloads.purposeText: Text generation, chat and working with documents. Available quantizations are shown before download.

downloads.quantAbout.IQ2_XS: Compact quantization with a balance of speed and quality.

downloads.quantAbout.IQ3_S: Higher precision with greater memory requirements.
downloads.quantAbout.IQ1_M: Coding variant with mixed expert precision to reduce memory use.
downloads.quantAbout.coding: A model variant for programming and working with code.
downloads.quantAbout.general: Native Strata variant with automatic preparation of required files.
downloads.quantAbout.llama: Ready-to-download GGUF for chat and everyday text tasks.
